label: Colour laser all-in-one, wired + wireless
description: 28 ppm colour laser all-in-one with 10/100/1000Base-T Ethernet and 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi. Gigabit wired plus wireless, both live at the same time.
notes: Wired is gigabit (10/100/1000Base-T) while wireless is 802.11b/g/n - asymmetric links are realistic here. No PoE, mains powered.
